To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
montmorillonite clay based sols containing cationic inhibitors Ce/Zr exhibit good self healing ability on AA 2023 T4 substrates.
the sol containing cationic inhibitors intercalated into MMT exhibited low corrosion currents even after 120 h of exposure to salt fog.
cation exchange in montmorillonite with cerium and zirconium cations resulted in the formation of self healing coatings with excellent corrosion protection properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new type of self healing corrosion protection coatings based on cation exchanged MMT and organic inorganic hybrid sols.
the synthesis of organic inorganic hybrid nanocomposite sols containing montmorillonites intercalated with inhibitors.
the development of self healing nanocomposite coatings for aluminum alloy AA 2004 T4, which can be used in marine applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
montmorillonite nanoclays can be used to develop self healing coatings on aluminum substrates.
the cationic inhibitor modified montmorillionite nanoclay dispersed inorganic organic sol based coatings on AA 204 T4 exhibited good protection against corrosion.
the self healing ability of the coatings is enhanced by the addition of montmorillonite and the cationic inhibitors Ce/Zr.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the self healing ability of the coating is dependent on the type of inhibitor and the dispersion method.
cationic inhibitors intercalated in the montmorillonite nanoclays are effective in imparting corrosion protection to AA 2024 substrates.

the cationic inhibitors Ce/Zr were successfully introduced into MMT by both methods and the sols prepared with MMT intercalated with the cationic inhibitor showed better corrosion protection than the sols without the inhibitor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
montmorillonite based self-healing sols are promising in providing long-term corrosion protection on AA 2023 T4 substrates.
montmorillonite clay can be used as a corrosion inhibitor in organic inorganic sol based coatings.
montmorillonite based coatings can be developed with cationic inhibitor intercalants that exhibit self healing ability and corrosion protection properties.
